title: gpt-oss-20b MXFP4 on SGLang, DGX Spark
slug_note: The official MXFP4 weights on SGLang on the Spark: 41 tok/s on one stream, the slowest of four engines on the same weights; boots only with --disable-flashinfer-autotune.

variation.quant_detail: MXFP4, 13.76 GB (official safetensors; MoE experts in MXFP4 as OpenAI shipped them)
variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of openai/gpt-oss-20b served on the Spark during the 2026-11-04 test (offline from the local cache)

engine.config: sglang.launch_server in the lmsysorg/sglang:qwen38-27b image, context 16,384, up to 4 requests, half the memory pool, FlashInfer autotune off

requirements.notes: Not measured. The lab run reserved half of the 128 GB pool (0.50 memory fraction), which is a reservation, not the model's need. 16 GB is OpenAI's stated footprint for the 20B.

steps.text: Run the command inside the lmsysorg/sglang:qwen38-27b image with --gpus all, host networking, --shm-size 16g and your Hugging Face cache mounted.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (676-681-token prompt, 256-256 output tokens); SR-98 four-engine comparison (same bench script, same prompts, context 16,384 on every engine); SGLang 0.0.0.dev0+qwen38.27b.g561c8f3 in lmsysorg/sglang:qwen38-27b (sha256:febfb971c735), command as shown

caveats: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-11-04) as the SGLang leg of the SR-98 four-engine run: the same official MXFP4 weights ran at 81.6 tok/s on llama.cpp, 58.48 on Ollama, 47.2 on vLLM and 40.85 here (short summarise prompt, median of 3).

Without --disable-flashinfer-autotune the server crashed at boot on the Spark (2026-11-04): FlashInfer's MoE autotuner hit "CUDA error: an illegal instruction was encountered". With the flag it booted and all 12 bench runs completed.

With this command the reply text carried the raw gpt-oss channel markup (for example `<|start|>assistant<|channel|>final<|message|>OK`): no reasoning parser was set, so chat UIs will show the analysis channel.
The image is the SGLang build tagged qwen38-27b (sglang 0.0.0.dev0+qwen38.27b.g561c8f3), the image the lab had on disk; a stock SGLang release was not tried.
